question: A person runs at an average speed of 20 km/h for 30 minutes and cycles at a speed of 32 km/h for 1 hour 15 minutes. Calculate the average speed (in km/h, rounded off to 1 decimal place).
solution:
**Given:**

Average speed of a person while running = 20 km/h

Time taken by person in running = 30 minutes

Average speed of a person while cycling = 32 km/h

Time taken by person in cycling = 1 hour 15 minutes

**Concept Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Convert the time taken in hours by dividing the minutes by 60,

⇒ So, 30 minutes = (30)/(60)=0.5&nbs
